title: 48 Swahili Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Swahili for Beginners (Perseverance)
description:
Learn 48 essential Swahili phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Swahili #LearnSwahili #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in Kiswahili, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Swahili with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 48 real-life phrases
- Kiswahili audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Perseverance · Uvumilivu
1:25  Confidence · Kujiamini
2:36  Sports & Fitness · Michezo na Mazoezi
4:01  Emergency & Health · Dharura na Afya
5:21  Hotel & Accommodation · Hoteli na Malazi
6:38  Growth · Ukuaji
8:03  Agreeing & Disagreeing · Kukubali na Kukataa
9:20  Ordering Food & Dining · Kuagiza Chakula na Kulia

PHRASE LIST

PERSEVERANCE · Uvumilivu
• I’ll keep showing up today. - Nitaendelea kujitokeza leo, hata kama ni kidogo tu.  [Nitaendelea kuJITOKEZA leO, HATA kama ni KIDOGO tu.]
• I can pause without quitting. - Naweza kusitisha kidogo bila kuacha.  [NaWEza kuSI TISHA KI Dogo bila kuAcha.]
• I’m learning how to hold on. - Ninakua jinsi ya kushikilia.  [NaKUa JINsi ya kuSHIkiLIA.]
• Small wins still count today. - Ushindi mdogo bado una maana leo.  [USHINdi mdogo bado U na MAana leO.]
• I’m stubborn in a kind way. - Nina ukakamavu kwa upole, si kwa vita.  [NiNA uKAKAmavu kwa UPOle, si kwa VIta.]
• I refuse to stop at the hard part. - Nakataa kukoma kwenye sehemu ngumu.  [NaKATAa kuKOMA kwenye SEhemu GUmu.]

CONFIDENCE · Kujiamini
• I can do this, slowly. - Naweza kufanya hivi, polepole.  [NAWEZA kufanya HIVI, POLEPOLE.]
• I trust my pace today. - Ninaamini mwendo wangu leo.  [NINAAMINI MWENDO wangu LEO.]
• I speak with quiet strength. - Napongea kwa nguvu tulivu.  [NAPONGEA kwa NGUVU tulivu.]
• My body knows, I listen. - Mwili wangu unajua, nasikiliza.  [MWILI wangu unaJUWA, NASIKILIZA.]
• I don’t fear being misunderstood. - Sinaogopa kutoeleweka.  [SINAOGOPA KUtoELEWEKA.]
• I keep my eye on progress. - Nachukua tahadhari kwa maendeleo yangu.  [NACHUKUA tahadhari KWA MAENDELEO yangu.]

SPORTS & FITNESS · Michezo na Mazoezi
• I stretch gently, no forcing. - Ninanyoosha kwa upole, si kulazimisha.  [NaNYOOSHA kwa UPOLE, si kuLAZIMISHA.]
• I warm up, then I go hard. - Ninaanza na maandalizi, kisha naongeza nguvu.  [NINAANZA na maanadalizi, kiSHA naONGEZA NGUVU.]
• Today I train smart, not loud. - Leo nazoezi kwa akili, si kwa makelele.  [LEO naZOEZI kwa AKeLi, si kwa maKELELE.]
• Form first, my ego later. - Mwili wangu kwanza, kiburi baadaye.  [MWILI wangu KWANZA, KIbiRi baADEYE.]
• I cool down, so I recover well. - Nafanya mazoezi ya kushusha mwendo, ili nijirehemu vizuri.  [Nafanya maZOEZI ya kuSHUsha mwenDo, ili niJAREHEMU vizuri.]
• I choose water over sweet drinks. - Ninachagua maji kuliko vinywaji vya sukari.  [NinaCHAGUA maJI kuSHINDA viNYWAji vya SUkaRi.]

EMERGENCY & HEALTH · Dharura na Afya
• Call poison control, please right now - Piga simu kituo cha sumu, tafadhali sasa  [Pi ga SIMU KITUO cha SUMU, tafadhali SA-SA]
• I think I swallowed something dangerous - Nadhani nimekula kitu hatari  [Na-dhan-ni ni-me-ku-la KI-tu ha-ta-ri]
• Do not give me food or drink - Usinipatie chakula wala kinywaji  [U-si-ni-pa-tie cha-ku-la wa-la ki-nywa-ji]
• I have severe bleeding, help me - Nina damu nyingi inayotoka, nisaidie  [Ni-na DA-mu NYI-ngi i-na-yo-to-ka, ni-sa-i-die]
• Apply pressure to stop the bleeding - Bonyeza sehemu inayotoka damu ili isimame  [Bo-nye-za SEH-MU ya-ni-yo-to-ka DA-mu i-li i-si-ma-me]
• The wound is getting worse fast - Jeraha linazidi kuwa baya haraka  [Je-ra-ha li-na-zi-di ku-wa ba-ya HA-ra-ka]

HOTEL & ACCOMMODATION · Hoteli na Malazi
• Is the room ready for early check-in? - Je, chumba kipo tayari kwa kuingia mapema?  [Je, CHUMBA kiPO TAyaRI kwa KUingia MApea?]
• Could I get a room with a view? - Naomba chumba chenye mwonekano, inawezekana?  [NaOMba CHUMBA chenye mwoNEkano, inaWEZekana?]
• Where can I recharge my phone? - Ninaweza kuchaji simu yangu wapi?  [NAnaweza KUchaJI simu yangu WAPI?]
• Do you have an elevator I can use? - Mna lifti, naweza kuitumia?  [MNA LIfti, naWEza KUItumia?]
• Is there hot water in the shower? - Maji ya moto yanapatikana kwenye oga?  [MAji ya MOto YAnaPATikana kwenye Oga?]
• I’d like an allergy-friendly room, please. - Naomba chumba kisicho na mzio, tafadhali.  [NaOMba CHUMBA kisicho na MZIO, taFAdhali.]

GROWTH · Ukuaji
• Today I practice one brave skill. - Leo nafanya mazoezi ya ujuzi mmoja wa ujasiri.  [Leo na-fanya ma-zo-ezi ya u-juzi MOJA wa u-ja-si-ri.]
• I grow when I ask, not guess. - Ninakua nikiuliza, si kukisia.  [Na-na-kua ni-ki-u-liza, si ku-KI-si-a.]
• I track progress, not just feelings. - Naangalia ukuaji kwa vitendo, si hisia tu.  [Na-an-ga-li-a u-ku-aji kwa vi-TENDO, si HI-sia TU.]
